eesti_pank_new_housing_loans.description: Estonia, MFI interest rate statistics (compiled by Eesti Pank, published via the ECB Data Portal)
eesti_pank_new_housing_loans.avg_rate_new_business_series: MIR.M.EE.B.A2C.A.R.A.2250.EUR.N (loans to households for house purchase, new business incl. renegotiations, all fixation periods)
eesti_pank_new_housing_loans.next_release: Eesti Pank Q3 2026 interest-rate statistics release on 2026-11-19 08:00 (per Eesti Pank press page); October bank statistics on 2026-11-25

eesti_pank_lending_rules.dsti_stress_rate: higher of contract rate or 6% for variable-rate loans
eesti_pank_lending_rules.exception: Each bank may issue up to 15% of quarterly new housing-loan volume outside these limits

eis_housing_loan_guarantee.how_to_apply: Through the bank; no separate application to EIS
eis_housing_loan_guarantee.guarantee_size: up to 24% of collateral value, max €20,000; energy-efficient group max €50,000; large families up to 40%, max €50,000
eis_housing_loan_guarantee.fee: 3% of guaranteed amount, one-off at signing; large families 2%
eis_housing_loan_guarantee.term_over_30y_conditions: borrowers' age at loan end max 70 and property built or fully renovated within the last 10 years
eis_housing_loan_guarantee.no_other_home_rule: Young family, young specialist, energy-efficient, tenant and veteran groups: borrower may not own a home at application, unless it is sold within 12 months
eis_housing_loan_guarantee.payment_holiday: Loan holiday possible until a child turns 3

target_groups.young_family: Parent aged up to 35 with at least one child up to 16, or parent aged up to 40 with at least two children up to 16
target_groups.young_specialist: Aged up to 35 with higher, vocational secondary or professional education, employed (probation ended) or in office, or sole proprietor active at least 1 year
target_groups.energy_efficient: Buying an energy-efficient home or renovating to energy efficiency; proven by energy label or calculation
target_groups.large_family: At least three children up to 19
target_groups.veteran: Defence Forces or Defence League veteran (foreign mission or injured in service)
target_groups.returned_dwelling_tenant: Tenant in a dwelling returned under ownership reform

eis_rural_housing_loan_guarantee.min_down_payment_pct: 15% of project value; 5% or 10% if borrower also belongs to another EIS target group
eis_rural_housing_loan_guarantee.guarantee: up to 80% of outstanding principal, max €150,000
eis_rural_housing_loan_guarantee.loan_cap: €200,000 and up to 95% of purchase/renovation cost
eis_rural_housing_loan_guarantee.fee: 1% per year of guarantee balance, paid monthly
